newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice futures not trade with money out.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice futures not trade with money out.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures did not trade on Wednesday with most investors staying on the sidelines, traders said.
Traders said investors did not want to build fresh positions after Tuesday's liquidation of positions by both long and short position holders.
"Capital continued to flow out of the rice market today into the stock markets and other active futures markets," one trader said.
Traders said trade would remain slow in the next few days.
